description: Files scripts/docker_entrypoint.py, scripts/docker_db*.sql, setup_database_finish.sql, Dockerfile and Python tests. Specs: default migrate/start; explicit provisioning input contract; automatic persistent random credentials, lock, atomic DBA-owned receipt, validation-only restart. Tests first: mode dispatch, engine detection errors, credential separation, rollback/receipt crash recovery, missing or conflicting receipt/state, real psql bootstrap/restart and ACL checks. Branches: fresh, retry, already provisioned, foreign migrated DB, lost secrets, changed target. Mock only subprocess boundary for unavailable Docker; real local psql integration where available. Docs database-setup. Coverage target 95%, measure Python orchestration and document Docker/SQL exceptions.
title: [zaq-f6s] Implement dual-mode entrypoint and atomic bootstrap receipt
